method.gpu: Completed non-disjoint EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 query around renderer commands; excludes compositor/display.
method.input: Synthetic pointermove and ArrowRight dispatched to the real canvas once per rAF; all geometry is the actual App scene.
method.resourcePasses: Asserted same final Earth layer profile/mode after each pass; pass0 warms lazy resources; next3 passes repeat hovers, independent remembered view profiles, dates, layer/mode switches.
method.workloads: Actual UI layer/filter/view/mode states asserted and recorded before timing. Earth default has aspects and projected houses off; geographic stress explicitly enables all40 lines plus projected houses; dense Outside explicitly enables every reference layer and aspects.
